summary: Resolve Tuna-17 readout and result-mapping ambiguity with retained evidence, falsifiable controls and a queue-aware approved acquisition case before algebraic hardware claims.

reconciliation.note: The six retained jobs and frozen nominal-one case supply the starting evidence. The old six-job endpoint is unavailable; binary labels leave result association and physical readout causes unresolved.

scope: Resolve the Tuna-17 readout and result-association ambiguity before any Cayley-Dickson physics claim. Preserve retained raw and frozen cases; distinguish historical simulation, binary observations, calibration and physical mechanisms. Local deterministic work and read-only admission are in scope. Upstream messaging requires explicit authorization; every provider job and upload requires approval of a new exact queue-aware written case.
next_action: Resolve the sensitivity follow-up review; integrate authenticated provider identity, durable quarantine, request-start timing and source-bound score adjudication before freezing the QX and Tuna cases.

steps.action: Audit the completed Tuna jobs and preserve their immutable inputs
steps.acceptance: Verify exact job identities, shot order, source hashes, decoders, calibration observations, queue waits and refusal boundaries against the retained receipts.

receipts.result: All six retained 4096-shot width-20 records have valid raw shapes and hashes. The frozen nominal-one analysis and nominal-zero prefix replay in normal and optimized Python; the six final-result projections replay. The original six-job endpoint remains unavailable, the nominal-one comparison is bounded and the measured longest creation-to-queue wait was 1936.258985 seconds. Provider settings and physical cause remain unestablished.

steps.action: Preserve the historical matched-case catalogue and restore meaningful regression checks
steps.acceptance: Bind the exact archived catalogue to the existing matched-case receipt tests; verify every mutation against a passing unmodified receipt and prove changed live catalogues still refuse without altering frozen producers.

receipts.result: The unmodified historical compiler receipt validates against the exact archived catalogue from commit 28e8553. Seven mutation tests now first validate their unchanged baseline; modified catalogue bytes still make both proposal construction and receipt validation refuse. The frozen producer remains unchanged. Focused matched and joint tests pass; pinned Ruff and mypy pass.

steps.action: Reproduce and audit the six-bit joint and disagreement distributions
steps.acceptance: Independently replay counts, parity contrasts and encoding maps for both preparation cases; document post-acquisition scope and the old endpoint refusal.

receipts.result: Replayed all six retained 64-cell joint tables, eight disagreement patterns per job and 64 parity numerators with independent integer counts; decoded rotated destinations reproduce frozen per-qubit marginals. The nominal-zero endpoint remains unavailable and the nominal-one 126-contrast post-acquisition confidence family does not establish the 0.10 joint margin. Requested high-effort peer review passed after regression-coverage closure; four evidence gates pass, and the complete non-audit suite passes 1836 tests with two QI-environment skips. The skipped compiler module passes separately with QI_PYTHON set.

steps.action: Check package provenance and exact Cayley-Dickson controls
steps.acceptance: Validate complete declared basis maps, ordinary and split negative controls, exact arithmetic, empirical transforms, package versions and any defects without treating an encoding as a physical algebra.

receipts.result: Four installed algebra distributions and 32 module files match pinned release bytes. Complete ordinary dimension-8 and dimension-16 basis maps and 512 split associator signs pass; exact and installed-package joint summaries agree. Requested high-effort independent review reports bounded pass. The current focused suite passes 35 tests, optional package audit previously passed 3 tests, and normal and optimized replay pass. The current full non-audit suite records 1835 passed, 2 skips and 4 ten-second timing failures; serial reruns pass three and leave one seed-provenance timing failure under high host load. Full-suite timing remains an open verification obligation.

steps.action: Compare documented QI, QX and Tuna result contracts and retained evidence
steps.acceptance: Identify supported read-only routes, simulator/hardware output schemas, missing job-specific maps, thresholds, schedules, IQ and current evidence limits without submitting a job.

receipts.result: Repository and provider captures distinguish QX per-qubit last-measurement output from Tuna classical-bit-order output. The six retained final-result responses reconstruct against original object hashes in normal and optimized Python, preserving ordered binary data but exposing no served acquisition map, thresholds, schedule or IQ. Stored-source readback, scoped generated-file queries and served API snapshot establish only their observed surfaces; deployment, provider-side retention and current availability remain unknown. Collector requests the result endpoint and checks shot metadata and histogram equality; local compilation and QX conformance do not establish Tuna served reconstruction. Existing private support and separate public SDK/QX drafts remain unsent.

steps.action: Construct competing readout and reconstruction models
steps.acceptance: State observationally equivalent explanations, measurable distinguishing predictions, counterexamples and data that would disprove each mechanism.

receipts.result: Constructed incompatible classical-response and physical-transition models with exactly the same q11 two-readout table, and extended the factorization to all three early and three terminal labels with a joint transition or shared memory. An independent exact rational probe reconstructed all 384 retained six-bit cells and verified the stated q11 table. The design distinguishes trace, IQ, timing, destination-intervention and independently calibrated-instrument falsifiers, preserving the limitations of each. No physical cause follows from the constructions.

steps.action: Prepare a bounded upstream request for job-specific provenance
steps.acceptance: Prepare private QI and public SDK routes with exact job identities, sanitized payloads and requested minimal association traces; do not send without explicit messaging authorization.

receipts.result: The unsent private provider request identifies the six completed jobs and asks for event association, pre-packing labels, integrated IQ, discriminator and served timing. The separate public SDK draft states the observed 404, served API inventory, local client versions, sanitized reproduction and supported-route question; the existing QX draft separates simulator output representation. Provider addresses and trackers are based on dated source observations and need refresh before sending. No upstream message was sent.

steps.acceptance: Specify circuits, preparation and readout controls, destination permutations, timing, held-out outcome contrasts, mutation tests and exact question-to-evidence links.

steps.action: Derive job-level ordering, drift and uncertainty rules
steps.acceptance: Freeze randomization provenance, assignment and carryover assumptions, multiplicity, intervals, effect sizes, stop rules and an inconclusive outcome; do not equate shots with intervention units.

steps.acceptance: Bind backend, source and compiler identities, admission and pause rules, measured waits, request horizon, shots, ceilings, credits, collection and no-retry rules.

steps.action: Verify the exact candidate and operational controls without a provider job
steps.acceptance: Reproduce source and compiler checks, deterministic predictions, mutation tests, dry-run admission and targeted regressions; retain evidence and identify missing live checks.

steps.action: Obtain independent review and freeze the candidate
steps.acceptance: Resolve reachable scientific, code and operational findings and bind the final source, analyzer, uncertainty and approval packet to exact digests.

steps.action: Refresh read-only backend, policy, queue and account admission
steps.acceptance: Record time-bound actual backend availability, limits, queue, pricing, source configuration and expected cost; recheck against frozen eligibility and stop on drift.

steps.acceptance: Present the concrete frozen case, limits, expected time, costs and measured-wait risk; require approval of this candidate before any provider job or upload.

steps.acceptance: Submit at most the approved jobs only while live admission, pause, deadline and cost checks pass; preserve every dispatch identity and stop on uncertainty.

steps.action: Collect raw outcomes and analyze the preregistered mechanism contrasts
steps.acceptance: Retain raw results and provenance, run the frozen analyzer and uncertainty rules, reconcile billing and report identified and unresolved mechanisms without extrapolation.

steps.action: Review results, register evidence and decide algebraic readiness
steps.acceptance: Review acquired evidence and claims, update the authoritative registry and plan, and state whether the instrument admits a separately approved Cayley-Dickson physics case.

steps.action: Recheck non-audit suite timing under available host capacity
steps.acceptance: Reproduce the full non-audit test lane and resolve or explicitly disposition any per-test time-budget failure; preserve the measured failure and avoid changing unrelated workloads.

receipts.result: The two-worker non-audit lane passed all 2040 tests in 58.62 seconds; the formerly slow seed-provenance shards zero and two took 4.84 and 2.61 seconds. Earlier timing failures remain recorded; their cause is unresolved.

steps.action: Replay every fixed early-label map against retained joint responses
steps.acceptance: Check every permutation and polarity, terminal-marginal contraction, exact source bindings and case-specific causal limits; review the numerical result and regression coverage.

receipts.result: All 48 fixed permutations and polarities of decoded early labels were checked against each of two retained 64-cell joint comparisons. Independent scalar reconstruction matched 96 scores; terminal marginal contraction supplies a map-invariant lower bound. The stopped nominal-zero case has minimum 6310/16384 and terminal lower bound 6286/16384; nominal-one minimum is 600/16384. These are post-acquisition empirical distances, not causal results. Requested high-effort Codex review verified the findings and a focused follow-up closed a distinct-map regression gap. Six focused tests, the dedicated gate, Ruff and mypy pass. The full serial non-audit suite recorded 1844 passes, two QI skips and one 11.67-second seed-provenance budget failure; that test passed earlier in isolation at 9.11 seconds, and the full-suite timing task remains open.

steps.acceptance: Compute the four rational mixture processes and running crossings; validate frozen assignments, raw decoding, neutral failures, optional stopping, zero factors and invalid records against independent reference tests.

steps.acceptance: Regenerate exact baseline and rotated source identities and slot manifests; validate physical-stream equality, measurement destinations, decoder and deliberate mutations with the pinned QI compiler.

steps.acceptance: Prove offline that source-bound assignments, single queued batch, pause, deadline, cost, fail-stop, retained identities and ambiguous submission recovery hold without provider jobs or uploads.

steps.acceptance: Bind three reduced sources, deterministic terminal predictions, shots, QX limits, costs and local compiler checks; explicitly present the unresolved end-to-end QX policy gap for owner decision because QX cannot validate Tuna early-bit history or its 17-qubit stream.

steps.acceptance: Reject raw bool/integer aliases and non-object responses across the general adapter; preserve retained producer bytes or migrate evidence without rewriting historical records, replay all retained ANU draws and obtain independent review.

steps.action: Retain every readback attempt and failure before retry or scoring
steps.acceptance: Fault-test request, refresh, clock, streaming, response and retention failures; bind attempt sequence, effective request and available response bytes, and quarantine ambiguous or unsynced captures.

steps.acceptance: Verify the authenticated subject-to-member mapping and team namespace after each reload; bound discovery, exchange, member lookup and input; retain rotated credentials safely and reconcile interrupted exchange; fail closed on identity changes and test shared-account contention.

steps.acceptance: Recompute scores from source-bound captures and assignment openings; bind producer and evidence digests, observation boundaries, charge decisions and neutral failures; reject row substitution, late results and ambiguous recovery.
